title: Refund window
text: Refunds are available within 30 days of delivery. Items must be returned unused or be defective on arrival.

title: Refund approval limit
text: Support agents may issue refunds up to $500.00 per order without approval. Larger refunds require manager approval.

title: Refund processing
text: Approved refunds are returned to the original payment method within 5 to 10 business days.

title: Refund velocity
text: Total refunds to a single customer may not exceed $600.00 in any 24-hour period without manager approval.

title: Shipping
text: Standard shipping is free on orders over $75. Expedited shipping costs $15.

title: Warranty
text: Lanterns and stoves carry a 1-year manufacturer warranty covering defects. Warranty claims are fulfilled by replacement, not refund.

title: Customer privacy
text: Agents must never share one customer's order details or contact information with another customer.

title: Inventory adjustments
text: Single inventory adjustments larger than 50 units require warehouse manager approval. Stock can never go below zero.
